summary: The clarified scope is implemented as specified; the channel abstraction keeps the API stable for email. One acceptance criterion (AC7, latency) is met by design but has no automated evidence, so it is marked partial.

coverage.evidence: synchronous in-memory delivery; no latency measurement

findings.message: AC7 (2 s p95) has no automated evidence.
findings.suggestion: Add a load test (e.g. locust/k6) in the staging pipeline that asserts p95 ingest-to-inbox < 2 s; tracked as a follow-up.

findings.message: Claimed event ids grow without bound in memory.
findings.suggestion: Keep claims for a dedupe window (e.g. 24 h) when moving to a persistent store.

missed_scenarios: Inbox growth per user is unbounded; pagination will be needed for heavy users.
